{{Hatnote|1=For the 2009–2014 virtual pool, see [[Virtual Legacy]]. For other uses, see [[Legacy]].}}
'''Legacy Open''' is the constructed format of Decipher-printed cards plus the pre-[[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset|2014 reset]] virtual pool (black-diamond [[:Category:Virtual Legacy sets|Virtual Block]] cards). The [[Players Committee]] calls it '''Legacy''': it created the Legacy format at the 2014 reset as a fixed card pool for the cards the reset removed.<ref name="reset-announce">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format], Advocate Council (byline darkjediknight11), Players Committee (25 July 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170306155342/http://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Internet Archive, 6 March 2017]</ref><ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The [[2014 World Championship]] was the last championship-circuit event on that pool.<ref name="afg" />

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee (as Legacy, 2014)
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus the pre-reset ("Legacy") Virtual Cards
* '''In use:''' championship pool until 2014; a fixed format since the 2014 reset
* '''Also called:''' Legacy (Players Committee, GEMP)
* '''GEMP:''' ''Legacy'' (<code>legacy</code>) on both the Players Committee GEMP and play.swccg.com

This is not [[Open]] (post-reset / current virtual constructed).

== Card pool ==
The Players Committee's 2015 guide defines Legacy events as constructed tournaments in which players build their decks from any Decipher cards and the "Legacy Virtual Cards", the Virtual Cards made before the reset. These carry a black diamond icon with the Virtual Block number inside. The guide calls it "the playing environment as it was prior to the Virtual Card Reset" and points to the Master DS and Master LS PDFs of the cards.<ref name="afg" /> The Players Committee's 2019 Tournament Formats page describes Legacy as 60-card Light and Dark decks using any Decipher cards and/or cards from the "legacy Virtual Sets", with no "standard" Virtual Cards.<ref name="pc-formats-2019">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/tournament-formats/ Tournament Formats], Players Committee (27 June 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210122060510/https://www.starwarsccg.org/tournament-formats/ Internet Archive].</ref>

On GEMP the matching environment code is <code>legacy</code>. The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp-ec48dc19">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021114513/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/swccgFormats.json.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022040117/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="lib-ec48dc19">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/game/formats/SwccgoFormatLibrary.java SwccgoFormatLibrary.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021121011/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/SwccgoFormatLibrary.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022041206/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/game/formats/SwccgoFormatLibrary.java Internet Archive].</ref> The Players Committee GEMP definition lists Decipher set ids 1&ndash;14, premium ids 101&ndash;112 and set 601. play.swccg.com adds 18 set numbers from 1200 to 1292 and the <code>loreHeroicRule</code> setting.<ref name="pc-gemp">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021130403/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/swccgFormats.json.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="gemp-ec48dc19" /> Both definitions link to the Players Committee's Legacy page, starwarsccg.org/legacy/.<ref name="pc-gemp" /><ref name="gemp-ec48dc19" />

== History ==
Before the reset this pool was the championship constructed pool.<ref name="afg" /> The 25 July 2014 "Reset of Standard Format" announcement made post-reset cards the new Standard format ([[Open]]) and said: "we also will create a new Legacy format for tournament events." All pre-reset virtual cards would stay in one Master Legacy PDF on the Players Committee site. Legacy was to be a fixed card pool that tournament directors could run at their discretion; no cards would be added or errata'd unless enough support was given for a Legacy card that needed adding or tweaking, at Design and Development's discretion.<ref name="reset-announce" />

The 2015 guide lists Legacy beside Standard as one of the two primary types of constructed event.<ref name="afg" /> The Players Committee's decklist archive files its pre-reset decklists, starting with 2007, under "Legacy Decklists".<ref name="pc-legacy-2007">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/category/tournament-decklists/legacy-decklists/2007-decks/ 2007 Decks Archives] (category Legacy Decklists), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201129041113/https://www.starwarsccg.org/category/tournament-decklists/legacy-decklists/2007-decks/ Internet Archive].</ref>

The name "Legacy Open" is this wiki's title, pairing the format with [[Open]]; Players Committee sources and GEMP call it Legacy.<ref name="afg" /><ref name="pc-gemp" />
